services.title: Socket and Switch Installation

services.title: Appliance Installation

services.title: Electric Heating and Boiler Services

about_pullquote: We treat every job like we'd do it in our own home — no shortcuts, always thorough.
about_para_1: ASK Electrical NE Ltd has been serving Newcastle and the surrounding areas for over 12 years. We started with a simple mission: provide honest, reliable electrical work at fair prices. Today, we've built a reputation for turning up on time, diagnosing problems quickly, and leaving homes safer and more functional than we found them.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen to what they actually need, explain the work clearly, and never oversell. We're Part P certified, all our installations are tested and certified, and we stand behind every job. From emergency midnight call-outs to planned rewires, we handle it all with the same care and attention.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Had an issue with a tripped consumer unit on a Sunday afternoon — thought I'd have to wait until Monday. Rang ASK and they came out within the hour. Turned out to be a dodgy appliance causing it. Fixed it properly, explained everything, and the bill was fair. Really impressed.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: We needed our kitchen rewiring when we fitted new units. Rather than rip everything apart, Mark and the team carefully planned it so we could still use the space. Finished on time, left the place spotless, and all the new circuits work beautifully. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Jennifer K.

reviews.text: Our house is from the 1970s and needed a full rewire. We were nervous about the disruption, but ASK organised everything so well. They tested and certified everything properly, gave us a thorough handover, and I feel so much safer now. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Robert T.
